verdict.rationale: Rippling is an API-bearing SaaS platform, so issuing scoped API credentials is a fair axis to judge. The evidence covers role-based permissions for employees and payroll access, plus general API, CLI and developer-sandbox availability. None of it documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API tokens or keys for a programmatic agent; employee role permissions are an adjacent control and do not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
